en-US.longDescription: Inquisit Lab turns a Windows or Mac computer into a local psychological testing platform for administering and programming psychology experiments, with data saved locally to the device and support for custom tests and integration with EEG, fMRI, and eye trackers.
en-US.name: Inquisit

zh-CN.longDescription: Inquisit Lab 能将 Windows 或 Mac 电脑变成本地心理测试平台，用于施测和编程心理学实验，数据保存在本机设备上，支持自定义测试以及与 EEG、fMRI 和眼动仪集成。
